meta.name: game-qa
meta.description: Verify a game with evidence on its selected target runtime. Launch the actual build and check logs, real rendering, input and state changes, the core loop, designed outcomes, restart, target display modes, interface language, first-time onboarding, and whether the core fantasy is actually performed — without dressing subjective fun up as a certain verdict. Use for test a generated game, QA a game build, check whether the game is fully playable, verify the build. 游戏证据化质量验证。在选定的目标运行环境中启动实际构建，检查日志、真实画面、输入与状态变化、核心循环、设计要求的结果、重开、目标显示模式、界面语言、首次上手与核心幻想是否真正出现，不把主观趣味包装成确定性结论。用于测试生成游戏、检查游戏能否完整游玩等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行游戏构建，用证据验证每个环节可玩
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚构建完游戏，想确认它真能完整跑通。
copy.tagline_en: Launch the real game build and verify every segment is playable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just built a game and need to prove it actually plays end to end.

howto.what: Claude 会实际启动游戏构建，检查日志、画面、输入、核心循环、重开、界面语言、首次上手与核心幻想，对照设计文档核实数值，生成 QA 报告与试玩协议。它只记录证据，不下“好不好玩”的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求测试生成游戏、对游戏构建做质量检查，或确认游戏能否完整游玩时，Claude 会启动验证流程。

say.text: 帮我测试这个生成游戏，看看能否完整游玩
say.note: Claude 会启动构建并跑完整检查

say.text: 对这份游戏构建做 QA，检查画面、输入和重开
say.note: 逐项核对运行证据并生成报告

say.text: 验证游戏在目标平台上是否真的能跑，给我证据
say.note: 不凭主观判断，只记录实测结果

howto.what_en: Claude launches the build, checks logs, rendering, input, core loop, restart, UI language, onboarding, and core fantasy, then writes a QA report and playtest protocol. It records evidence, not subjective fun.
howto.when_en: When you ask to test a generated game, QA a game build, or check whether a game is fully playable, Claude starts the verification.

say_en.text: Test this generated game and tell me if it's fully playable
say_en.note: Claude will launch the build and run checks

say_en.text: Run QA on this game build: rendering, input, restart
say_en.note: It verifies each item with evidence

say_en.text: Verify this game actually runs on the target platform
say_en.note: It reports measured results, not opinions
